title: DravyaSetu Knowledge Response
description: Canonical response returned by Person 3 Knowledge Service to Person 2 Spring Boot. Verified against the deployed service (POST /knowledge/chat) OpenAPI schema, version 1.0.0.

request_id.description: Echo of the request_id supplied by Spring Boot.

session_id.description: Conversation session identifier supplied by Spring Boot and echoed back.

detected_language.description: Language the service detected in the input.

transcript.description: Speech transcript. Always null for text input.

sources.description: Grounded knowledge sources used to build the answer.

voice_output.description: Synthesised audio metadata. Null unless generate_audio was requested.
